Comment: Fluxer music bot configuration. Requires Node.js >= 22.13.0. Run 'node --version' to verify.

rest.Comment: REST client options. 'timeout' is ms before a request to api.fluxer.app is aborted (default: 15000). Raise if you see DOMException AbortError in logs.

fluxer.js.instance-Comment: Using a self-hosted Fluxer instance? Add an 'instance' object here with your domain's URLs (api, gateway, media, ...). See README -> Self-hosted Fluxer instance. Leave it out to use the official fluxer.app.

errorLogChannel.channelId: paste the ID of the channel that should receive error logs
errorLogChannel.Comment: Forward error logs and crash reports to a Fluxer channel. Every logger.error line (and every logger.warn line when forwardWarn=true) is posted there: player failures, node disconnects, database errors, plus fatal crash reports (uncaughtException, unhandledRejection) with uptime and memory. startupMessage=true sends a one-time 'Log channel connected' confirmation at boot through the real send path — if it fails, the console shows the exact permission/ID problem. forwardInfo=true ALSO forwards logger.info lines (boot activity, joins, recoveries) — useful for full visibility but much noisier; keep false for errors-only. Identical messages are deduplicated for 60s, sends are spaced by minIntervalMs, and floods beyond maxQueue pending messages are dropped with a summary line instead of spamming. Test delivery any time with the owner-only 'logtest' command. channelId: enable Developer Mode in the Fluxer app, right-click the target channel and copy its ID — the bot must be able to send messages there. Fully disabled unless enabled=true AND channelId is set.

presenceContents-Comment: Each entry can be a plain string (e.g. 'Ping for Prefix') or an object. Objects support: text (required), emoji_name (unicode emoji or custom emoji name), emoji_id (snowflake ID for custom guild emojis only), activity ({ name, type, url? }). Activity types: 0=Playing, 1=Streaming, 2=Listening, 3=Watching, 5=Competing. For custom guild emojis, provide both emoji_name AND emoji_id. For unicode emojis, only emoji_name is needed.

nodelink.Comment: requestTimeout: ms before a NodeLink HTTP request is aborted. Default: 60000 (60s). Raise if you see 'NodeLink request timeout' errors. All audio sources (Spotify, Deezer, Apple Music, etc.) are resolved by NodeLink, so configure source credentials in nodelink.config.json, not here.

audio.Comment: Playback runs on NodeLink's /v4/trackstream endpoint only: WebM/Opus zero-re-encode passthrough, stale URLs auto-retried with a fresh resolve, and seeks handled in-process by the bot (no FFmpeg anywhere). Leave allowLoadstream = false unless you specifically need the legacy /v4/loadstream route. Set it to true only if your audio node exposes /v4/loadstream — it re-enables: server-side audio filters (bassboost, nightcore, ...), MP3/AAC/PCM sources (radio stations, Bilibili's AAC audio), and NodeLink-side seeking. loadstream is what required FFmpeg in the past. crossfadeSeconds / skipCrossfadeSeconds: smooth transition between songs at the end of a track and on skip (0 = off).

bilibili.Comment: Bilibili video playback (%play https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV... , b23.tv short links and ?p= parts included) — fully anonymous, no cookies needed. The bot talks to Bilibili's WBI-signed web API (survives the HTTP 412 risk-control blocks that hit plain API calls on many hosting IPs), prefers anonymous DASH audio (~130-170 kbps) and falls back to the html5 progressive mp4 for videos without DASH audio. Bilibili's CDN only serves audio to requests with a bilibili Referer, so the bot runs a tiny local HTTP proxy that adds those headers and hands a signed URL to your NodeLink/Lavalink node. Defaults work when the node runs on the same host as the bot (nodelink.host = localhost). bind/port: what the proxy listens on (port 0 = pick a free port). advertiseHost: the host your audio node should use to reach the proxy — set it (e.g. your bot's LAN IP or Docker service name, and bind 0.0.0.0) only when the node runs on a different machine. buvid3/buvid4/b_nut device cookies are generated and managed automatically. remoteProxy/remoteSecret: for split deployments where the audio node cannot reach the bot host — deploy the header-proxy as a Cloudflare Worker (download/bilibili-proxy-worker.js), then set remoteProxy = https://<worker>.workers.dev and remoteSecret = the worker's SECRET variable. When both are set, signed URLs point at the remote proxy and the local proxy never starts (audio flows Bilibili CDN -> worker -> node; the bot needs no inbound ports).

comment-radio.message: If you have radio stations you'd like to connect, add them to the array below. Radio stations must be rendered like following:

station.name: zamrock
station.url: url to stream from; this will be kept private

lastfm.Comment: Last.fm integration: auto-scrobble songs, play loved/top/recent tracks. Register at https://www.last.fm/api/account/create

fluxerlist.Comment: FluxerList.com integration (docs.fluxerlist.com). Generate your own API key: FluxerList Dashboard -> Developer tab -> generate (starts with fl_, shown once). While enabled, the bot auto-posts its server count to your bot listing: once at startup, then every statsIntervalMinutes (default 30; endpoint allows 12/hour; identical counts are skipped to conserve the shared 3000 requests/month key budget). botId: your bot's Fluxer ID — leave empty to auto-detect at startup. serverId/serverSlug/botSlug: optional, used by the vote command. Set autoStats=false to disable the server-count sync only (vote command keeps working).

Comment2: The above specifies the time in ms after which a player goes inactive; Optional.
customStatsFooter: Text shown in the footer of the $prefixstats embed; optional.

logging.Comment: Control which log categories appear in the console. Set 'enabled' to false to silence everything except errors. Set any category to false to silence just that group.

timers.Comment: All timing values in milliseconds (ms). 1000ms = 1 second, 60000ms = 1 minute.

voiceCommands.Comment: Voice commands: the bot listens in the voice channel and runs commands said after the wake word (e.g. 'DJ, skip'). Needs the whisper container: docker compose --profile voice up -d. The Whisper models are English-only, so use English command names.

donate.Comment: Link shown by %donate and the Donate button in the web panel. The bot stays free; donations unlock nothing. Set enabled to false to hide it, or put your own link in url.

invite.Comment: Optional. %invite builds the add-to-server link automatically (your Fluxer web app + the bot ID + the needed permissions). Set url to replace the whole link, or clientId / permissions to override just those parts.

web.Comment: Built-in web control panel (player, queue, search, settings, status, logs). Disabled until you set a password. language: 'en' (default) or 'ro' for a Romanian panel. Served on port 8080 inside the container (8090 on the host by default).

oauth.Comment: Optional Login with Fluxer for server managers (they only see servers where they have Manage Server). Needs HTTPS, the application client secret and the redirect URI <panel address>/api/oauth/callback registered on Fluxer.
